inputForm.earlyRetirementDesc: What age do you plan to start FIRE?
inputForm.earlyRetirementTooltip: The age at which you plan to voluntarily retire early (FIRE). For example, 40 years old, assuming you have no income after this year. Programmers can try filling in 35.
inputForm.legalRetirementDesc: Age when you start receiving pension, usually no need to change
inputForm.legalRetirementTooltip: The age at which you start receiving pension. For simplicity, this calculator assumes your income after legal retirement is sufficient (i.e., 100% replacement rate).
inputForm.monthlyExpensesDesc: Including expenses during work and retirement (average)
inputForm.monthlyExpensesTooltip: Including your average monthly expenses while working and after early retirement. Although the time span is long, try to estimate based on your spending habits.
inputForm.currentSavingsTooltip: How much money you have saved, including deposits and low to medium-risk investments. Debt is not recommended to be included.
inputForm.monthlyPensionDesc: Monthly pension income after legal retirement
inputForm.monthlyPensionTooltip: The pension you expect to receive monthly after legal retirement. This income can supplement your daily expenses. Reference: National average about 3,000 CNY, first-tier cities can reach 4,000-5,000 CNY.
inputForm.expectedSavingsDesc: Savings you want to retain at retirement
inputForm.expectedSavingsTooltip: How much savings you want to have left when you reach legal retirement age (in current purchasing power). Generally speaking, pension may not fully meet your daily expenses, so it's better to have some savings. If you think pension can fully meet expenses (100% replacement rate), you can fill in 0.
inputForm.annualReturnTooltip: The average annual return rate you think your savings and investments will achieve. Reference data: Yu'e Bao 1.43%; CSI 300 average 5% in recent ten years; S&P 500 average 15.6% in recent ten years.
inputForm.inflationRateTooltip: Considering inflation, your saved money will become less valuable. You can fill in what you think is the long-term annual average inflation rate, default value 2%.

formula.title: Explanation
formula.coreDesc: This calculator uses year-by-year simulation + binary search method to precisely calculate the minimum monthly savings that meet retirement goals.
formula.realReturnDesc: Real return rate considering inflation impact:
formula.realReturnNote: Where r_nominal is the annual investment return rate, r_inflation is the inflation rate, and r is the annual investment return rate.
formula.savingsTrajectoryDesc: The calculator divides life into three stages and simulates savings changes year by year:
formula.workingPeriod: ① Working Period (Current Age → Early Retirement Age):
formula.earlyRetirementPeriod: ② Early Retirement Period (Early Retirement Age → Legal Retirement Age):
formula.legalRetirementPeriod: ③ Legal Retirement Period (After Legal Retirement Age):
variables: S_t = Total savings in year t
M_save = Monthly savings amount (target value solved by algorithm)
E_t = Annual expenses in year t (growing with inflation)
P_t = Annual pension in year t (growing with inflation)
formula.inflationAdjustment: 3. Inflation Adjustment for Expenses and Pension
formula.inflationNote: Where E_0 is the current annual expense, P_0 is the current annual pension, and t is the number of years passed.
formula.constraintsDesc: The algorithm uses binary search to find the minimum monthly savings that satisfies the following conditions:
constraintsList: Savings at legal retirement ≥ expected savings target
assumptionsList: Investment return rate and inflation rate remain stable
Pension starts from legal retirement age
Living expenses grow proportionally with inflation
Taxes and other factors are not considered
formula.note: Note: Actual calculations use numerical methods to ensure accuracy and stability of results.
